note: Suggestions, not a plan. Nothing here is booked or ticketed — it is a shortlist to pick from on the day. Add your own on the Spots page; anything you add lives in your browser until it is committed here.

spots.name: Weststrand
spots.note: Wind-bent pines and bleached stumps in the sand. Walk as far as you like; nobody is counting.

spots.name: Leuchtturm Darßer Ort
spots.note: Only reachable on foot or by bike from Prerow — about an hour each way. Lighthouse and the Natureum at the tip.

spots.name: Seebrücke Prerow
spots.note: Lunch, a pier, and the painted doors of the Darßer Bauernhäuser nearby.

spots.name: Ahrenshoop
spots.note: Artists' colony at the far end of the peninsula. Galleries and the Schifferkirche.

spots.name: Pramort
spots.note: Crane-watching platform at the eastern tip. Dusk is the hour.

spots.name: Königsstuhl
spots.note: The chalk cliffs. Walk in on the Hochuferweg from Sassnitz rather than driving up.

spots.name: Kap Arkona
spots.note: Two lighthouses and a steep coast at the northern tip of Rügen.

spots.name: Vitt
spots.note: Thatched fishing hamlet below Kap Arkona. Cars stay outside.

spots.name: Seebrücke Sellin
spots.note: The pier on our own front page. Best at dusk.

spots.name: Jagdschloss Granitz
spots.note: Cast-iron spiral staircase and a view over the south of the island.

spots.name: Prora
spots.note: Four and a half kilometres of unfinished Nazi holiday camp. Genuinely strange.

spots.name: Ozeaneum
spots.note: Baltic tanks and a hall of life-size whales. A good rainy-day answer.

spots.name: Teepott Warnemünde
spots.note: Swooping 1960s roof by the lighthouse, wide beach beside it.

spots.name: Seebrücke Zingst
spots.note: Two minutes from the apartment. Walk out on it as the light goes.
